title: eleusine brevifolia
intro: Eleusine brevifolia, commonly known as grass of the gods, is a perennial plant species of the Poaceae family. It is known for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, making it a potential treatment for cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Eleusine brevifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
